exercises.title: Bài mẫu – Cement and Concrete Production (20 phút)
exercises.instruction: The diagrams below show the stages and equipment used in the cement-making process, and how cement is used to produce concrete for building purposes. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.

stimulus.caption: Cement Production và Concrete Production (Gravel = small stones)

targetStructures: The diagrams illustrate the production of cement and how cement is used to make concrete.
It is clear from the diagrams that there are five stages in the process of making cement, while only two steps are required to produce concrete.
At the first stage of the process, … · This … is then … · The process continues with … · At the final stage, …
in the proportions of 50%, 25%, 15% and 10% respectively

scoring.criterion: Task Achievement – đủ 4 phần; Overview nêu số bước cho CẢ HAI quy trình; mô tả đủ mọi bước, không thêm bước thừa
Coherence & Cohesion – 5 từ nối trình tự khác nhau; Body 1 = cement, Body 2 = concrete
Lexical Resource – từ vựng quy trình (crush, mix, heat, grind, package) + tên máy đuôi -er
Grammatical Range & Accuracy – bị động hiện tại đơn chính xác; ít nhất một cấu trúc rút gọn (before being ground)

checklist: Introduction paraphrase, dùng 'the production of' hoặc 'how cement is produced'
Overview 2 câu: 5 bước cho xi măng, 2 bước cho bê tông
Toàn bài thì hiện tại đơn, thể bị động
Không mô tả 'gravel' hay tỉ lệ % như một bước riêng — gộp vào bước trộn
Tối thiểu 150 từ
rubric.sampleAnswer:
The diagrams illustrate the production of cement, and how cement is used to make concrete.

It is clear from the diagrams that there are five stages in the process of making cement. Meanwhile, only two steps are required to produce concrete.

At the first stage of producing cement, limestone and clay are put through a machine called a crusher and become powder. This powder is then mixed and brought into a rotating heater, where it is heated at a high temperature. The process continues with grinding the material, and then cement is produced. At the final stage, the cement is packaged into bags and is ready for the production of concrete.

The first step of making concrete is combining different materials. Cement (15%) is mixed with water, sand and small stones in the proportions of 10%, 25% and 50% respectively. This mixture is then put into a concrete mixer, where it becomes the final concrete, which can be used for building purposes.
commonErrors: dùng thì quá khứ
coi 'cows grazing' / byproducts là một bước
thiếu Overview

exercises.title: HOMEWORK — Đề 2: Brick manufacturing (bài hoàn chỉnh)
exercises.instruction: The diagram below shows the process by which bricks are manufactured for the building industry. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.

stimulus.caption: Brick manufacturing process
stimulus.note: Body 1: 3 giai đoạn đầu (dig clay → shape bricks). Body 2: 4 giai đoạn sau (dry → fire → cool → package & deliver).

targetStructures: Overall, there are … stages, beginning with … and ending with …
checklist: Đủ 7 giai đoạn, không bỏ bước
Bị động hiện tại đơn
Body 1 = 3 giai đoạn đầu, Body 2 = 4 giai đoạn sau
rubric.sampleAnswer:
The diagram illustrates the process by which bricks are manufactured for the building industry.

Overall, there are seven stages in the process, beginning with the digging of clay and ending with the delivery of the finished bricks.

At the first stage, clay is dug from the ground by a digger. It is then placed onto a metal grid and passed through a roller, after which sand and water are added. The mixture is then either put into a mould or cut by a wire cutter to make individual bricks.

Next, the bricks are dried in a drying oven for 24 to 48 hours. They are then heated in a kiln, first at a moderate temperature and then at a high temperature, before being cooled in a cooling chamber for 48 to 72 hours. Finally, the bricks are packaged and delivered to their destinations.

exercises.title: PRACTICE — The life cycle of a bee (Introduction, Overview, Body 1, Body 2)
exercises.instruction: The diagram shows the life cycle of a bee. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words. Dùng thể chủ động, thì hiện tại đơn.

stimulus.caption: Life cycle of a bee
stimulus.note: Body 1 (3 giai đoạn đầu): (1) a female bee lays 1–2 eggs every three days; (2) the eggs hatch after about 9–10 days; (3) the young bee goes through the first moulting after about 5 days. Body 2: (4) second moulting after around 7 days; (5) a young adult bee emerges about 9 days later; (6) around 4 days to become fully mature.

targetStructures: The diagram illustrates the stages in the lifespan of a bee.
Overall, the life cycle of a bee consists of several stages and takes about 34–36 days to complete, beginning with eggs and ending with a fully mature adult bee.
First, … · After about … days, … · The young bee then …
checklist: Introduction paraphrase, không chép đề
Overview nêu số giai đoạn, điểm đầu và điểm cuối, có thể nêu tổng thời gian
Dùng thể CHỦ ĐỘNG (Natural Process), thì hiện tại đơn
Có ít nhất 2 từ nối trình tự khác nhau
rubric.sampleAnswer:
The diagram illustrates the different stages in the life cycle of a bee, from the laying of eggs to the emergence of a mature adult.

Overall, the life cycle of a bee consists of six stages and takes about 34–35 days to complete, beginning with the female laying eggs and ending with a fully mature adult bee. It is also clear that the young bee moults twice before it becomes an adult.

The cycle starts when a female bee lays one or two eggs every three days. After about nine to ten days, the eggs hatch, and the young bee goes through its first moulting roughly five days later. This is followed by a second moulting after another seven days, during which the bee continues to grow in size.

About nine days after the second moulting, a young adult bee emerges. It then takes around four more days for the bee to reach maturity. At this point, a female is able to lay eggs, and the cycle begins again.

exercises.title: HOMEWORK – The life cycle of the salmon (bài hoàn chỉnh)
exercises.instruction: The diagram below shows the life cycle of the salmon. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.

stimulus.caption: Life cycle of the salmon
stimulus.note: Body 1 (3 giai đoạn đầu): eggs laid in fresh water → hatch after ~3 months into alevin → alevin feeds on the yolk sac for several weeks then becomes fry. Body 2: fry (5–10 weeks) begin swimming → grow into parr with 'finger' markings → become smolt after 1–3 years and move to the sea → 1–6 years in the ocean as adult → return to fresh water to spawn and die within two weeks.

targetStructures: The diagram illustrates the stages in the life of a salmon.

After about … , the eggs hatch and become …
The fish then grows into … before moving to …

scoring.criterion: Task Achievement – đủ 4 phần; Overview nêu điểm đầu/cuối; mô tả đủ mọi giai đoạn, không bỏ sót
Coherence & Cohesion – chia thân bài 2 đoạn cân đối; ≥5 từ nối trình tự khác nhau
Lexical Resource – từ vựng vòng đời (hatch, feed on, grow into, spawn) chính xác
Grammatical Range & Accuracy – CHỦ ĐỘNG, hiện tại đơn xuyên suốt; ≥1 cấu trúc nối bước (Once / before + V-ing)

checklist: Dùng thể CHỦ ĐỘNG (Natural Process), thì hiện tại đơn cả bài
Overview: bắt đầu từ trứng ở nước ngọt, kết thúc khi cá trưởng thành quay về đẻ trứng
Nêu các mốc thời gian (3 months, 1–3 years, 1–6 years) như trong sơ đồ
Không mô tả thông tin nền như một giai đoạn
Tối thiểu 150 từ
rubric.sampleAnswer:
The diagram illustrates the life cycle of the salmon, from eggs in fresh water to adult fish that return to spawn.

Overall, the life cycle of a salmon consists of eight stages, beginning with eggs in fresh water and ending with adult salmon returning to fresh water to spawn.

The cycle starts when eggs are laid in fresh water, and they hatch after about three months. The young fish, known as alevin, then feed off their yolk sac for several weeks. After that, they develop into fry, which are 5 to 10 weeks old and are able to swim.

Over the following months, the fry grow into parr and develop finger-like markings on their sides. When they are one to three years old, they become smolt and swim out to sea in groups. The salmon then spend one to six years at sea as adults before returning to fresh water, where they spawn and die within about two weeks.

exercises.title: PHẦN B – Bài viết mô tả quy trình (60 điểm)
exercises.instruction: The diagram below shows how orange juice is produced and delivered to shops. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words. You should spend about 20 minutes on this part.

stimulus.caption: The production of bottled orange juice
stimulus.note: 9 bước chính (harvesting → delivery); “animal feed” là sản phẩm phụ, không phải một bước.

targetStructures: The diagram illustrates the process by which bricks are manufactured.
Overall, there are seven main stages in the process, beginning with the digging of clay and ending with delivery to customers.
At the first stage, … · After that, … · Once … · Having been … , … · Finally, …

scoring.criterion: Task Achievement – đủ 4 phần; Overview nêu số bước + điểm đầu/cuối; mô tả đủ 7 giai đoạn, không thêm bước thừa
Coherence & Cohesion – Body 1 = 3 giai đoạn đầu, Body 2 = 4 giai đoạn sau; ≥5 từ nối trình tự khác nhau
Lexical Resource – từ vựng quy trình (dig, roll, mould, kiln, cool) + tên máy đúng
Grammatical Range & Accuracy – bị động hiện tại đơn xuyên suốt; ≥1 cấu trúc nối bước (Once / Having been / before being)

checklist: Overview: 9 bước, bắt đầu bằng harvesting, kết thúc bằng delivery
Nhắc sản phẩm phụ (pulp and peel → animal feed)
Bị động hiện tại đơn
Không bỏ bước pasteurising / cooling
rubric.sampleAnswer:
The diagram illustrates how bottled orange juice is produced and delivered to shops.

Overall, there are nine main stages in the process, beginning with the harvesting of oranges and ending with the delivery of the finished juice to shops. It is also clear that the pulp and peel removed during production are used to make animal feed.

At the first stage, oranges are picked by hand and transported by truck to a factory, where they are washed in cold water. The clean oranges are then put through a juice extractor, which squeezes the juice out of the fruit. After that, the juice is filtered so that the seeds and pulp are removed, and this waste, together with the peel, is used as animal feed.

Next, the juice is pasteurised by being heated to 90°C for 30 seconds before being cooled to 4°C. Once cooled, it is packaged into cartons and bottles. Finally, the products are delivered to shops in refrigerated lorries.
commonErrors: dùng chủ động (workers dig the clay)
bỏ sót giai đoạn làm nguội
thiếu Overview

targetStructures: The life cycle of a frog consists of …
checklist: Thể chủ động, thì hiện tại đơn
Đủ các giai đoạn: eggs → embryo → tadpole → froglet → adult frog

rubric.sampleAnswer: The life cycle of a frog consists of five main stages. It begins when an adult female frog lays eggs in a pond. After a few days, an embryo develops inside each egg, and the eggs then hatch into tadpoles, which live in the water and breathe through gills. Over time, the tadpoles grow back legs and then front legs, while their tails become shorter. At this stage, they start to breathe through lungs. Finally, the tail disappears completely, and the young frog becomes an adult frog, which can live both in water and on land. The adult frog then lays eggs, and the cycle begins again.
commonErrors: The eggs are hatched (sai — quy trình tự nhiên dùng chủ động: The eggs hatch)

exercises.title: HOMEWORK — Đề 1: Milk production (bài hoàn chỉnh)
exercises.instruction: The diagram below shows the process of milk production. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.

stimulus.caption: Quy trình sản xuất sữa (Milk production)
stimulus.note: Sáu bước: vắt sữa → làm lạnh/bảo quản → xe bồn chở về nhà máy → lưu trữ tại nhà máy → tiệt trùng (heating) & đóng gói → vận chuyển đến cửa hàng. “Cows grazing” là thông tin nền; cheese, cream, butter là sản phẩm phụ — không tính là bước.

targetStructures: There are … main stages in the process of …, beginning with … and ending with …
Once / Having been / After being / followed by
checklist: Introduction paraphrase
Overview nêu số bước, bước đầu và bước cuối
Không coi cows grazing hay sản phẩm phụ là một bước
Bị động, thì hiện tại đơn
rubric.sampleAnswer:
The diagram illustrates how milk is produced, from the milking of cows to the delivery of milk to shops.

Overall, there are five main stages in the process, beginning with the milking of cows by machine and ending with the distribution of the packaged milk to supermarkets and shops.

At the first stage, cows are milked by machine twice a day. The milk is then stored in refrigerated tanks before being collected by a milk tanker, which delivers it to the dairy every day.

At the dairy, the milk is pasteurised and packaged into bottles, while some of it is used to make by-products such as cheese, cream and butter. Finally, the packaged milk is transported to supermarkets and shops, where it is sold to customers.
commonErrors: Coi “cows grazing” là bước 1
Mô tả cheese, cream, butter như một bước của quy trình

rubric.sampleAnswer:
1. The life cycle of a butterfly consists of four main stages.
2. It begins when a female butterfly lays eggs on a leaf.
3. After a few days, the eggs hatch into tiny caterpillars.
4. The caterpillars feed on leaves and grow rapidly.
5. During this stage, they shed their skin several times.
6. Once fully grown, each caterpillar forms a hard shell called a chrysalis.
7. Inside the chrysalis, it gradually develops into an adult butterfly.
8. Finally, the adult butterfly emerges, and the cycle begins again.
